query: How to write $x_i - x_j$ in terms of $r$ and $\Theta^a$?
response:
From the definitions
b^{[i,j]}_k=\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}(A_{ik}-A_{jk}),\qquad r\cos\Theta^{[i,j]}=\mathbf{b}^{[i,j]}\cdot\mathbf{y}=\sum_{k=1}^{N-1}b^{[i,j]}_k y_k,
and x_i=\sum_{k=1}^N A_{ik}y_k (with y_N=\sqrt{N}X decoupling the CM),

we have
x_i-x_j=\sum_{k=1}^{N-1}(A_{ik}-A_{jk})y_k=\sqrt{2}\sum_{k=1}^{N-1}b^{[i,j]}_k y_k=\sqrt{2}\,r\cos\Theta^{[i,j]}.

FINAL RESULT:
\[
x_i-x_j=\sqrt{2}\,r\cos\Theta^{[i,j]}.
\]
Summary: used b^{[i,j]}_k=\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}(A_{ik}-A_{jk}) and r\cos\Theta^{[i,j]}=\mathbf{b}^{[i,j]}\cdot\mathbf{y}, together with x_i-x_j=\sum_k(A_{ik}-A_{jk})y_k.
